comparison.objective: Attach a rack rail versus retain a housing, roll a fixture over, lock it and fit a pad.
comparison.physical_skill: Separated-post prong alignment and fastening versus fixture loading, sliding-bar restraint, fixture rotation, bolt locking and recess insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Self-supporting level rail with correct prongs and screws versus correctly inverted, bolted housing with seated pad and cleared hands.
comparison.reason: Both stage multiple locks, but their tested kinematics and final assemblies differ materially. Candidate numerical damage and overload criteria are missing.
